methodology: Independent midpoint scan from raw request admission/completion intervals and manifest per-SSU V/C; U from layer overlap; SLO from request latency. No simulator run or metrics imports.

shared_settings.bandwidth_unit_assumption: configured numeric rates applied directly; no GiB-to-GB conversion

caveats: All regime names here refer to the warm [2,4) second window, not the entire finite workload.

Demand is sum of currently admitted requests per-layer bytes / pure layer compute time. It is not instantaneous IO submission rate, queue backlog, or actual throughput; next-request pre-admission L0 prefetch is not double counted.
Same-policy cross-regime comparison changes profile distributions, request counts, identity layout and shuffle rules. It is descriptive, not a controlled change to utilization alone.
Within each regime and seed, ASU and OD share the exact frozen manifest. Active warm cohorts may differ because policies change admission timing.
Use admission-based uncensored cohort [2,4) and follow through each request completion. Arrival-based latency includes queue waiting and is a different metric.

Actual plotted CDF x=(completion-admission)/own_compute; threshold x=1.5. Each seed has its own ECDF and the three ECDFs are averaged equally, matching the arithmetic mean of seed SLO values. Pooling all requests would use different weights.
Rates are GiB/s despite some field suffixes gb or gbps. Capacity is 40 GiB/s per disk, 120 GiB/s total.
Supply curve is measured backend service averaged over 10ms bins. Demand should be time-integrated to the same bins if overlaid; smoothed supply need not equal the nominal demand at every time.
Old diverse demand used >40+1e-8; this audit uses literal >40/<40 and matches all stored durations. No selected segment equals capacity exactly.

Cross-study schema differs: continuous has request_statistics/by_profile/full_population, diverse has slo_by_profile and lacks these fields. Common fields are analysis U_percent/slo/demand/SSD_GiB_s and raw summary request/layer metrics.

csv_schema_notes.raw_U_fraction_not_percent: summary.fleet_npu_compute_utilization is full-run fraction; do not use as warm percent
csv_schema_notes.window_selection: Both CSVs label [2,4) as warm_2_4s; safest raw selection is analysis start_ms=2000,end_ms=4000
csv_schema_notes.aggregation: For pooled CDF use sum(passed)/sum(count); arithmetic mean of seed percentages is distinct.
